summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing open-market share repurchases under its buy-back program announced 5 August 2026. On 24 August 2026, HSBC purchased 10,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of GBP 15.2112 per share, and 434,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at an average of HK$160.9594. Since program commencement, HSBC repurchased 18,727,014 shares for about US$385.9 million. All repurchased shares are cancelled, reducing issued share capital. Watch cumulative buy-back progress against the program's total authorization.
